current_implementation: ConnectionAuditor uses os.path.abspath(database) to check against blocked paths
technical_risk: If a test or script accesses quotations.db or structural_runs.db via a symlink outside the project tree
remediation_specification: abspath does not resolve the target
test_verification_method: allowing the symlink to bypass the blocked path check
gap_severity: Use os.path.realpath(os.path.abspath(database)) to resolve all symlinks to canonical filesystem inodes before comparison
remediation_status: Unit test creating a temporary symlink pointing to PROD_STRUCTURAL_DB and asserting that ConnectionAuditor intercepts it with RuntimeError

current_implementation: ConnectionAuditor checks raw string equality against file paths; ignores URI schemes
technical_risk: SQLite accepts URI connections such as file:quotations.db?mode=ro or file:///absolute/path/to/quotations.db; raw string comparison fails to match file URI strings against blocked file paths
remediation_specification: Parse database parameter using urllib.parse or re to strip file: prefix and query parameters (?mode=...) before resolving path

vulnerability_vector: Early Direct Function Import (from sqlite3 import connect)
current_implementation: ConnectionAuditor monkeypatches sqlite3.connect when IsolatedTestEnvironment.activate() is called
technical_risk: If any module executes from sqlite3 import connect before activate() is run
remediation_specification: that module holds a direct reference to the unpatched C-extension function
gap_severity: Patch both sqlite3.connect and sqlite3.Connection.__init__; also inspect sys.modules to update existing imported references or enforce activation at test runner initialization
remediation_status: Unit test verifying that a pre-imported connect alias raises RuntimeError when invoked with production path

vulnerability_vector: Direct File Write Operations (open / shutil / os.remove)
current_implementation: ConnectionAuditor only intercepts sqlite3.connect; file system operations on database files are unmonitored
technical_risk: A rogue test or faulty setup script could execute open('quotations.db'
remediation_specification: 'wb') or shutil.copyfile() directly modifying the file without calling sqlite3.connect
test_verification_method: Implement strict file-level SHA-256 pre- and post-test manifests verifying every single file in the repository
gap_severity: and set read-only file permissions (chmod 0444) on production databases during test suite execution

vulnerability_vector: Drawing and PDF Output Verification by Directory Count Only
current_implementation: Test suites verify production non-interference by checking directory file counts (e.g. 5 DXF files
remediation_specification: A test could overwrite an existing production drawing or PDF in-place without altering the file count
gap_severity: Replace directory count assertions with a cryptographic manifest checking individual SHA-256 hashes of all 5 DXF drawings and all 33 quotation PDFs before and after test execution
remediation_status: Unit test modifying a dummy file timestamp/content asserting manifest failure
